ask: A CRM for our sales pipeline: companies, deals and contacts. The agent drafts follow-ups when a deal goes to proposal; I approve every email before it sends.
name: CRM

data.line: Deal · name, company, stage (Lead → Won/Lost), next step, value, close date, owner
Contact · name, email, phone (hidden until revealed), company

automation.line: Deal moves to Proposal, or you ask → draft a follow-up email → approval: send

screens.line: Pipeline · full-width deals table, board by stage, bulk moves
Deal · one deal with its runs and approvals
Contacts · searchable list, add and edit contacts

agent.line: CRM agent · drafts emails, updates deals, answers pipeline questions
